sourceObservations: Outside combat, target type 1 selects one party character and target type 4 tracks the complete party before one resolvespell call.
resolvespell retains the ordinary shared duration then damage rolls and pays the learned spell's authored cost.
spelllist special 63 changes only a monster target by marking its magical loot slots; party character targets are unchanged.
Treasure Detect Magic uses a separate reward command and cost despite deriving eligibility from a character who knows a special-63 spell.
runtimeContract: All three stock Discover Magic records are legal field casts. They preserve their one-target or whole-party selection, cost, RNG order, and save state while leaving selected characters unchanged; Treasure detection remains a separate workflow.
